observations: Industrial sewing machine with a teal/grey painted body.
The text 'AIG BROTHER' is printed in blue on the main arm.
A sticker on the base identifies the model as 'AIG-DB8800'.
The machine is mounted on a white industrial sewing table with a ruler scale.
A thread stand and bobbin winder are visible on the table.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI NANCY ANAEBO' is present on the image.

claims.claim: Original Ambro Brother embroidery Sewing machine
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the brand is 'AIG BROTHER', not 'Ambro Brother'.
AIG Brother is a known clone brand, typically manufactured in China, unlike the original Japanese Brother brand.
Requires a video of the machine running to verify.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual
claims.evidence: No accessories or manual are visible in the photo.
Internal mechanical history cannot be determined from a photo.

risks.risk: The motor (usually mounted under the table) may be missing or faulty.
risks.proof: A photo of the underside of the table showing the motor and a video of it running.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as 'head only' without a motor.

risks.risk: The machine may have internal timing issues or worn parts despite the 'neat' exterior.
risks.proof: A video of the machine sewing a sample of fabric.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as requiring a full service/repair.

risks.risk: The table and stand might not be included in the sale price.
risks.proof: A wide-angle photo showing the complete unit (head, table, and legs).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the machine head only.

proof_requests: Video of the machine sewing through fabric to demonstrate the motor and stitch quality.
Photo of the motor and the complete table/stand setup.
Photos of the included accessories and manual.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as an AIG Brother AIG-DB8800 industrial sewing machine. Although the seller's description contains inaccuracies regarding the brand name and origin, the item can be priced as a clone model in its worst-case condition (head only, non-functional).
